_comment: POLICY layer. Course-wide rules lessons inherit. Tune here without touching any content file.

xp._note: A lesson awards baseXpPerLesson on completion; +perfectBonus if answered with no mistakes.

multiSelect.answer: array of int indices into options

orderBlocks.answer: array of int indices (a permutation of blocks)

tapTokens.answer: array of tokens in correct order

beats.MEET: Thinking only, no/minimal syntax. Mostly identify-I/O, order-the-plan, spot-the-flaw.
beats.TOOL: Introduce one construct with visible runnable output. Still at least half thinking.
beats.PRACTICE: Many guided problems, each walked through UEPCC. The product's core value.
beats.LOOP: Interleaved review of this lap plus earlier laps. No new concept.

authoring.overlap: ~70% new material, ~30% review of prior units (spaced repetition).
authoring.thinkingFloor: At least half of a CONTENT/TOOL unit's exercises must be about thinking, not syntax.
